body:
I had gotten vicodin for surgery on my elbow, although the pain was not that bad I decided to take two of 750 mg pills.  As I went to bed in my room I immediately slip into a dream.  I kept finding myself in my old house in my room on my bed.  Th room was dark and I think some other people were there.  I know something would freak me out and I would wake up an for about 30 seconds to a minute I would still think I was in that old room until I adjusted.  This scared me a lot and I stayed awake for about 5 minutes and then tried going back to bed again.  I immediately slipped back into the exact same location and was scared.  This happened aprox 4 times until I finally had to go sleep in someone elses room to calm me down.  I have taken vicondin many other times bc of previous injuries but I cant remember having such intense nightmares.
